candidates.name: Tuberculosis
support_spans: progressively worsening chronic dry cough with shortness of breath, night sweats, and unintentional weight loss of 7 kg over two months
dullness over right lower lung zone with reduced tactile vocal fremitus, decreased breath sounds, fine basal crepitations and increased vocal resonance
Opacification in right hemithorax with pleural effusion, left lung mid-wedge-shaped opacification
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings are consistent with pulmonary tuberculosis, and the presence of systemic symptoms such as fever, night sweats, and weight loss further support this diagnosis.

candidates.name: Disseminated Histoplasmosis
support_spans: cachectic with muscle wasting and poor oral hygiene including oral thrush
Three well-defined lesions within right basal ganglia and medial aspect of right superior frontal gyrus
candidates.why: The patient's immunocompromised status, as suggested by his homosexuality and oral thrush, increases his risk for disseminated histoplasmosis, which can cause both pulmonary and central nervous system lesions.

candidates.name: Pulmonary Nocardiosis
support_spans: dullness over right lower lung zone with reduced tactile vocal fremitus, decreased breath sounds, fine basal crepitations and increased vocal resonance
large area of non-enhancement within right lower lobe lung parenchyma suggesting liquefication related to infection versus necrosis
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings are consistent with pulmonary nocardiosis, which can cause lung abscesses and is more common in immunocompromised individuals.
